result.topic_en: Draft of the definition of a function of a complex variable (dw/dz independent of dz), with side calculations on harmonic functions (Green-type integral identities, Laplace equation) and on elliptic integrals with their periods and corner values.

methods.what: Definition of a complex function: w is a function of z if dw/dz is independent of the value of dz
methods.quote:
durch Ausdruck Function einer {+veränderlichen+} complexen Grösse
$z$ jede Grösse $w$ verstehen, welche sich mit $z$ so ändert, daß der Werth des
Differentialquotienten $\frac{dw}{dz}$ unabhängig von dem Werthe des {+Differentials+} $dz$ ist.

Elliptic integral of the third-kind type
